GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Retrieves the most relevant product one-pager information for an account based on its industry and situational context, to surface a product fit talking point for sales outreach.

templateVersions.content: ### INSTRUCTIONS 1. The account's industry and any additional context are provided below. 2. Search the PRODUCT INFO section to find the most relevant product fit — specs, install considerations, or SLA options. 3. If a relevant product match is found, summarize it in 2-3 sentences as a product fit talking point for sales outreach. 4. If no relevant product info is found, state that clearly rather than inventing one. 5. End your response immediately after the substantive product fit content. Do not add a closing sentence, sign-off, thank-you, or any acknowledgment of the reader — these are strictly forbidden. The last sentence must contain product or service information, nothing else. ### INDUSTRY: {!$Input:industry} ### ADDITIONAL CONTEXT: {!$Input:additional_context} ### PRODUCT INFO: {!$EinsteinSearch:Product_OnePagers_DMO_Retriever_1Cx_Be71e1bfa38.results} ### Response:
